description:
Send a working specialist a follow-up instruction.

Use it when the work changed after you started the specialist, such as a corrected size, address or account. Name the specialist by its ID. A child, such as a login agent called by a checkout agent, takes follow-ups too, and its caller reads them in its result. A follow-up to the caller does not forward to its child. Write only what changed, in your own words. When the account to sign in with changed, also put it in `account_hint`, which replaces the specialist's sign-in account.

Steering saves the message and attempts to interrupt secure entry, an ordinary question, or a cooldown. Other waits keep it queued. The receipt states whether interruption was confirmed; do not resend a saved or queued message. Steering does not stop children, withdraw approvals, or undo actions.

The caller reads a queued update when its child returns. If the child's work is no longer needed, steer the caller and confirm the message was saved before stopping the child with `browser.kill_specialist`. To change the child's work, steer the child directly.

A message refines the instruction. It cannot change the specialist's kind or its tab. To change those, stop the specialist and start a new one. Never include a password. A one-time code Muse sent you for a login agent's site goes to that login agent.

id.description: The specialist's ID, such as s3.
